verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents a built-in simulated card reader in its SDKs and server-driven integration, so developers can build and test without physical hardware or ordering a reader. The Stripe CLI also supports testing integrations. However, the evidence never describes a sandbox or test-mode environment that keeps test data separate from production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox/test-mode isolation from live data, test card or test key details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
